reply:
Implemented Kanban board UI
Details
Previewing

Your Kanban board is ready. All 11 requirements passed in a real browser at desktop (1280px) and mobile (375px) widths. Your cards are saved in this browser only, so they won't appear on other devices.

To move a card without dragging, open its ⋯ menu. It has Move to (another column), Move up, Move down, Edit and Delete, and it works with Tab and Enter.

What I tested and how:

Automated logic tests (21, all passing): adding, editing and deleting cards; moving cards within and between columns; the limit of 3 on Doing (no warning at 3, warning at 4); overdue rules (the due date itself isn't overdue, and nothing in Done is); search by title and description, ignoring capitals; the priority filter; and loading saved data, including damaged data.
Browser walkthrough, 19 checks per screen size, all passing at both sizes:
Empty columns show an empty message.
A card can't be saved without a title.
Added cards show their coloured priority label, and the count in each column header is correct.
The Doing warning appears at 4 cards and goes away at 3.
A past due date turns the card red, and the highlight goes away in Done.
Editing a card works.
Moving a card with the keyboard (Tab and Enter) works.
Dragging works with a mouse on desktop and with a finger on mobile, both between columns and within a column.
Search and the priority filter work, and "No cards match your search" appears with a Clear filters button.
Delete asks for confirmation: Cancel keeps the card, Delete removes it.
The board is unchanged after reloading the page, nothing scrolls sideways, and there were no page errors.
Problems found and fixed:
Dropping a card in the empty space below other cards sometimes didn't register. I changed how the drop spot is detected, and the full check then passed several runs in a row.
On mobile the columns were stretched far taller than their cards. They now fit their contents.
